```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Output DC is set by the balance between the PMOS load and the NMOS sink, so a small current mismatch rails the output (vout 1.64 V, M3 in triode). Add a kload knob to tune that balance near 0.9 V, and size M1 with higher gm/Id for more Vdsat margin."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":       (16e-6, 12e-6, 30e-6),  # branch current (driver = cascode)
    "L1":      (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # driver length
    "L2":      (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # cascode + reference length
    "L3":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load length
    "gmid1":   (12.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # driver gm/Id (higher -> lower Vdsat1 -> more M1 headroom)
    "gmid2":   (14.0, 9.0, 14.0),      # cascode gm/Id (higher -> lower Vgs2 -> more x headroom)
    "gmid_b":  (2.5, 2.5, 5.0),        # reference gm/Id
    "gmid_p":  (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "kload":   (1.0, 0.97, 1.03),      # PMOS load / driver current ratio: sets the output DC balance
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vin = spec["vin_dc"]
    CL = spec["cl"]

    # Driver, cascode, reference, load, mirror
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=0.5)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I, vds=0.5)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L2"], Iref, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], p["kload"] * I, vds=0.9)
    mbp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], Iref, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)                  # CS driver
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m2)               # NMOS cascode, gate = vbn
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)               # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("Mref", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)        # diode reference, carries Iref
    n.dev("Mn", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)            # NMOS copy sinks Iref from vbp
    n.dev("Mbp", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)              # PMOS diode sources Iref into vbp

    # First-order predictions
    vbn = mref.vgs
    x = vbn - m2.vgs
    x_margin = x - m1.vdsat
    vbp = VDD - mbp.vgs
    mn_margin = vbp - mref.vdsat
    vmin = x + m2.vdsat
    vmax = VDD - m3.vdsat
    vdc = 0.5 * (vmin + vmax)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vdc - vmin, vmax - vdc)

    Rcas = (m2.gm / m2.gds) / m1.gds
    Rout = 1.0 / (m3.gds + 1.0 / Rcas)
    A = m1.gm * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * CL)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * CL)
    power = VDD * (I + p["kload"] * 0 + 2 * Iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vdc,
        "swing": swing,
        "m1_headroom": x_margin,
        "mn_headroom": mn_margin,
    }
```
